courtroom-ink.$description: Courtroom Ink — Page canvas, primary background — near-black with a faint cool tint, not pure black; sets the midnight tone

lectern-surface.$description: Lectern Surface — Elevated card and panel surfaces sitting one step above the canvas; used for feature cards and link hovers

document-drawer.$description: Document Drawer — Input field backgrounds, form controls — one level above card surfaces to read as recessed

manuscript-white.$description: Manuscript White — Primary headings, body text on dark surfaces, ghost-button borders, and inverted text on coral CTAs

parchment.$description: Parchment — Light surface variant for cards on dark, light-mode button text, and subtle off-white highlights

ashen-type.$description: Ashen Type — Medium-contrast borders, control outlines, and structural separators.

smoke.$description: Smoke — Tertiary text, disabled states, and lighter dividers — sits between Ashen Type and Manuscript White

coral-verdict.$description: Coral Verdict — Primary action buttons (Book a Demo, Try Free) — the only warm hue on the page; signals decision points without aggression

indigo-statute.$description: Indigo Statute — Accent for select feature cards and section highlights — used sparingly to add editorial weight, never on actions

cyan-margin.$description: Cyan Margin — Inline links, logo gradient, and decorative icon strokes — cool counterpoint to the warm coral primary

arizona-mix.$description: Display headlines and section titles only. Weight 500 medium — not bold — lets the serifs do the work. Aggressive negative tracking (-0.04em at 77px shrinking to -0.02em at 28px) tightens the letterforms into an editorial, almost newspaper-headline feel. This is the signature choice: a custom serif in a SaaS context replaces the usual geometric sans and signals premium legal authority.

soehne.$description: All UI, body, button, badge, input, and subheading text. Neutral grotesque with even proportions; weight 400 for body, 500–600 for UI labels and buttons, 700 reserved for emphasis. Consistent -0.01em tracking across all sizes. The quiet counterpart to the loud display serif — Soehne is the workhorse, Arizona Mix is the voice.
